data.long_meaning: The name Palomina is of Spanish origin and is a feminine name that means 'little dove'. It is derived from the Spanish word 'paloma', which means 'dove'. The name Palomina is often given to girls born in the summer, as it is believed to represent the warmth and light of the sun. The name Palomina carries the meaning “Little Dove” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Palomina usually hope their child will grow to embody little dove and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Palomina is a name with deep spiritual meaning. It represents the gentle and nurturing qualities of a dove, which is a symbol of peace, love, and purity. Palomina is also associated with the sun, which represents warmth, light, and energy. In Christian mythology, the dove is a symbol of the Holy Spirit, making Palomina a name with strong spiritual significance.

The name serves as a reminder of the ultimate goal of living a life centered on the virtues of love, peace, and purity. Palomina may also symbolize the innocence and purity inherent in every person, inspiring those who bear this name to strive for spiritual growth and renewal.
